graph.name: Apply a names-and-terms glossary
graph.description:
Canonicalize known spellings and world terms with a deterministic glossary.

Lesson: A checked Data glossary replaces literals simultaneously without a model; protected wording keeps an intentional alternate title.

Limitations: Literal simultaneous replacement fixes configured terms only. It does not infer canon or merge identities.

Opening installs an unassigned copy. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Post: at most 0 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Add an evidenced from/to spelling pair and inspect each occurrence before applying.
Set caseSensitive false and test greyhaven; assess whether that use names the same place.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Before: The envoy returned to Greyhaven carrying a sun stone.

After: The envoy returned to Grayhaven carrying a sunstone.

Zero-call glossary path: glossary → decode → canonicalize.reference; reply.out → canonicalize.in; canonicalize → validate → review → apply. Zero models.

Canon is supplied: entries is supported glossary Data. phrase matches configured multiword text; protectedLiterals keeps artwork title. No identity or canon inference occurs.

Envoy's terms · frozen reply (reply)
Purpose: Freeze the latest completed text-only envoy-terms reply.
Fixture: The envoy returned to Greyhaven carrying a sun stone. The painting Greyhaven at Dusk hung by the door.
Inspect: Two Greyhaven occurrences, one sun stone; artwork title is intentional.

Grayhaven and sunstone · JSON canon (glossary)
Purpose: Supply two approved literal canon pairs.
Inspect: Review from/to decisions; keep artwork exception in protections.

Check literal glossary entries (decode)
Purpose: Parse and shape-check the glossary Data.
Inspect: Two nonblank from/to records; schema cannot establish canon.

Canonicalize terms, keep artwork (canonicalize)
Purpose: Canonicalize terms while keeping the artwork title.
Inspect: Grayhaven and sunstone change; Greyhaven at Dusk stays; no cascade.

Check substitutions and exception (validate)
Purpose: Validate spelling substitutions and exception.
Inspect: Check title protection and unrelated wording.

Review supplied glossary meaning (review)
Purpose: Require a contextual canon comparison.
Inspect: Verify same place/item identity; literals cannot disambiguate.

Offer canonical-terms reply (apply)
Purpose: Offer the canonical-terms reply.
Inspect: Full root Host result: compare terms, then Apply or Reject; no model required.
